actions.title: Recommended actions
actions.hint: In order of priority. Recalculated every time the page refreshes.

egress.t: TV egress is nearing the limit
egress.d: TVs already check only every 120 s at night. Next: move posters to Cloudflare R2, or upgrade to Supabase Pro (US${usd}, {quota}).

cached.t: Poster downloads are nearing the limit
cached.d: Move posters to Cloudflare R2 (no egress fees), or upgrade to Supabase Pro ({quota}).

db.d: Check that usage_screen_daily is trimmed (120 days) and old content is deleted, or upgrade to Supabase Pro ({quota}).

storage.d: Delete posters that ended more than 30 days ago, or upgrade to Supabase Pro ({quota}).

rps.d: Upgrade the compute size in Supabase → Settings → Compute, then update "Compute size" below.

email_day.d: Encourage AJK to sign in with Google (no email), or upgrade to Resend Pro (US${usd}).

mau.t: Active users are nearing the limit

backup.t: {n} masjids rely on a system without daily backups
backup.d: The Free plan has no automatic backups. Upgrade to Supabase Pro for 7 days of daily backups.

calibrate.d: The last real figures are more than 30 days old. Copy them from Supabase → Usage into the form below.
calibrate.never: Never calibrated. Copy the figures from Supabase → Usage into the form below.

email_sync.t: Email count is out of date
email_sync.d: The usage-digest function has not run for more than 50 hours. Check Supabase → Edge Functions → usage-digest → Logs.

snapshot.d: The masjidview-usage-snapshot cron job has not run for more than 2 hours. Check Supabase → Integrations → Cron.

prices.d: Prices were checked more than 6 months ago. Compare with supabase.com/pricing and resend.com/pricing.

none.d: Every limit is below {pct}% and projections stay within limits until the end of the cycle.

growth.flat: Not enough growth for a projection yet.
growth.notEnough: Not enough data yet. The chart appears after two weeks.

scale.title: Monthly cost as you grow
